npc_groups.communication_quirks: They are hyper-energetic and sarcastic. They treat everything like a joke or a competition. Their signage for a high-security vault might just be an image of a frowning face and a giant "NOPE" symbol.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Bright, expressive ancestries. Neon gear, street‑art‑style tattoos/symbols; lots of stickers and pop‑culture imagery.
npc_groups.demeanor: Competitive and playful in‑group; sarcastic and irreverent to outsiders.

npc_groups.name: The Lithos-Architects
npc_groups.lettering: Heavy, geometric cuneiform carved deep into the material.
npc_groups.language_oddities: The language is tactile and thermal. Each symbol is meant to be touched; the Architects use a slight heat-enchantment so the "important" words feel warm to the fingertip.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Heavy basalt slabs or thick lead bricks bolted directly into the hull. The writing is chiseled using diamond-tipped tools.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Dour and traditional. They view modern technology as "flimsy." Their signs often include the date the sign was made and the expected expiration date of the room (usually in thousands of years).
npc_groups.common_appearance: Sturdy, carved stone adornments; heavy geometric motifs in garments and tools.
npc_groups.demeanor: Serious and traditional internally; brusque and rigid with strangers.

npc_groups.name: The Glimmer-Flys
npc_groups.lettering: Patterns of reflected flashes, bright streaks, and dark intervals that blink in rapid sequences.
npc_groups.language_oddities: The sign changes depending on how fast you walk past it. If you stand still, it looks like a blur; if you run, the message becomes clear.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Long, thin strips of iridescent ribbon studded with tiny spinning mirrors or sequins, pinned in place with shimmering needles.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Hyper-active and distractible. They hate long sentences. A sign for a "Danger: Radiation Zone" might just be a flashing sequence that translates to "SHINY HURT."
npc_groups.common_appearance: Colorful ribboned outfits with reflective surfaces and sequins; kaleidoscope accessories.
npc_groups.demeanor: Energetic and flighty with each other and others; easily distracted.

npc_groups.name: The Bureau-Kraken
npc_groups.lettering: Tiny, microscopic dense text arranged in perfect, soul-crushing grids.
npc_groups.language_oddities: Every noun takes a suffix marking it as authorized, prohibited, or pending review. Exceptions attach as additional suffixes, so a single word can contain an entire chain of qualifications.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Laminated A4 paper attached with industrial-strength, nearly irremovable adhesive. Every sheet must be mounted level to within 0.1 degrees.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Pathologically bureaucratic. Even a storage-closet label may contain 4,000 words of legal disclaimers, safety protocols, and occupancy history. They insist that every notice follow the prescribed format.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Tidy uniforms, clipped badges, precise pins; often carry paperwork bundles.
npc_groups.demeanor: Obsessively precise with one another; irritatingly meticulous with outsiders.

npc_groups.name: The Rust-Walkers
npc_groups.lettering: Chemical corrosion patterns. The "letters" are actually controlled patches of rust or acid-burns.
npc_groups.language_oddities: The language smells like ozone and wet iron. To "read" it properly, one often has to sniff the sign.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Circular rusted canisters or hubcaps. The "ink" is concentrated salt-water or digestive acid applied with a coarse brush.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Deeply fatalistic. They believe the station is slowly dying and they worship the decay. Their signs are often found on things that are broken, proudly labeling them as "RETURNED TO DUST."
npc_groups.common_appearance: Patchworks of rusted metal, leather, and corroded relics; smell of ozone and iron.
npc_groups.demeanor: Fatalistic and quiet together; darkly humorous and resigned with outsiders.

npc_groups.name: The Star-Singers
npc_groups.lettering: Resonant hums, sustained tones, and warbling trills arranged into short musical phrases. Pitch, rhythm, and duration distinguish the acoustic characters; the visible staffs and notes provide a visual transcription.
npc_groups.language_oddities: If you tap the sign, it emits a low hum. The pitch of the hum tells you the "mood" of the room (a minor key for a morgue, a bright major chord for a kitchen).
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Curved glass tubes filled with singing sands. The tubes are bent into the shape of musical signatures.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Highly dramatic. They refuse to speak—only sing. Their signs are often hung in "acoustically pleasing" spots, even if that spot is twenty feet up a wall or behind a pipe.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Flowing robes, tunic‑like garments with musical motifs, glass tubes and singing sand ornaments.
npc_groups.demeanor: Dramatic and cooperative with each other; expressive and lyrical toward others.

npc_groups.name: The Hive-Mind of Sector 4
npc_groups.lettering: Abstract, organic splotches that look like coffee stains or grease marks.
npc_groups.language_oddities: Pheromone blends are perceived as vivid, spatial “colors,” allowing messages to function as scent-maps. The language has no singular first-person pronoun or individual possessive equivalent to “mine.”
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Rough burlap patches soaked in pungent oils. They are usually slapped onto walls at waist height (the height of their antennae).
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Radically communal. They address the collective and label places by shared function rather than personal ownership. A private bedroom would be described as “Collective Resting Niche #402.”
npc_groups.common_appearance: Organic splotches and scent‑soaked patches; minimal clothing but shared communal glyphs.
npc_groups.demeanor: Highly communal and consensus‑driven internally; disinterested or alien to outsiders.

npc_groups.name: The Chronos-Glitchers
npc_groups.lettering: Vibrant neon-tube characters with flickering strokes and doubled, slightly displaced outlines.
npc_groups.language_oddities: Written messages can overlap their own past or future versions. Readers may glimpse text from five minutes ahead, or obsolete room labels from before the station’s remodeling eighty years ago.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Acrylic boxes containing humming neon gas. They are almost always hung crookedly because the Glitchers exist in four dimensions and can't tell what "straight" looks like.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Constantly confused. They might thank you for a conversation you haven't had yet. Their signs are often apologetic, like "Bridge (Likely) This Way."
npc_groups.common_appearance: Flickering cloth with patterns that look displaced in time; time‑glyph adornments.
npc_groups.demeanor: Confused and nonlinear with each other; oddly polite or oddly ahead of schedule with outsiders.

npc_groups.name: The Trash-Goblins (Scavenger Guild)
npc_groups.lettering: Crude crayon drawings and stick figures.
npc_groups.language_oddities: The language uses a lot of "X" marks for things that are dangerous and "Circle" marks for things that can be eaten.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Flattened soda cans or pieces of cardboard. The writing implement is usually a half-melted crayon or a piece of charcoal.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Aggressively protective of loot. They use signs to claim territory. You’ll see a sign on a vending machine that just says "MINE" with a very poorly drawn picture of a bite mark.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Ragged scraps, cardboard and found metal; marked with simple symbols (Xs, circles).
npc_groups.demeanor: Territorial and mischievous inside the group; defensive and opportunistic outside it.

npc_groups.name: The Order of the Void-Eye
npc_groups.lettering: The sign is a solid block of color, and the letters are the holes cut out of it.
npc_groups.language_oddities: You can only read the sign by looking at what isn't there. If the wall behind the sign is the same color as the sign, it is completely invisible.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Square sheets of black silicone. They are often placed over lights so the "letters" are projected onto the floor.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Highly secretive and elitist. They think if you can't see their signs, you don't deserve to find their rooms. They get very annoyed if someone shines a flashlight on their "invisible" doors.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Simple dark robes or cloth with negative‑space sigils; often minimalistic gear.
npc_groups.demeanor: Secretive and solemn with each other; dismissive and cool to outsiders.

npc_groups.name: The Party-Bot Renegades
npc_groups.lettering: Rainbow-colored static and pixelated icons that hurt the eyes to look at.
npc_groups.language_oddities: Deliberate glitches are grammatical marks: a dropped pixel negates an icon, a color shift changes tense, and a repeated frame adds emphasis. A still image can lose essential parts of the message.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Discarded tablet screens or broken monitors taped to the wall with neon duct tape.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Inappropriately enthusiastic. They greet passersby with one-second loops of high-tempo electronic dance music and treat every room transition like a VIP club entrance. Even a nuclear-reactor sign gets festive streamers and a “LET’S GOOO!” icon.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Glitchy neon screens, patched circuits, luminous streamers.
npc_groups.demeanor: Highly enthusiastic internally; overly friendly and chaotic externally.

npc_groups.name: The Hierophant’s Hand
npc_groups.lettering: Ornate, sweeping golden calligraphy featuring numerous loops, halos, and decorative flourishes that make the text look like art.
npc_groups.language_oddities: Verbs have distinct inflections for divine commands, mortal requests, and prophecies. Using the wrong form changes a statement’s authority or certainty.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Silk banners with gold-tasseled fringes, or hammered gold-leaf plates fastened with silver screws. Inked lettering is often scented with sandalwood or myrrh.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Incredibly polite but immovable in their religious convictions. They regard the station’s layout as a divine map and conclude every notice with “By the will of the Hierophant.” Removing or defacing a sign is considered heresy and may provoke a holy investigation.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Ornate clerical vestments, gold filigree banners, sacred symbols.
npc_groups.demeanor: Reverent and orderly among themselves; formal and solemn toward others.

npc_groups.name: The Station Normals
npc_groups.lettering: Standard block lettering that is clear, legible, and entirely devoid of artistic flair.
npc_groups.language_oddities: No unusual language features; this is ordinary Basic Common.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Square pieces of white paper or yellow sticky notes attached with clear tape. Occasionally, they just write directly on the wall with a black permanent marker.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Polite and Literal. They are the "straight men" of the station. They value safety, clear directions, and social niceties. Their signs often include small pleas for civility, such as "Please don't eat the glowing moss" or "Kindly keep noise down after 10 PM."
npc_groups.common_appearance: Everyday clothing styles from their home cultures; common tools and simple garb.
npc_groups.demeanor: Cooperative and polite both internally and with outsiders.

npc_groups.name: The Vacuum-Born
npc_groups.lettering: Transparent indentations or microscopic etchings that are invisible from a distance.
npc_groups.language_oddities: The text can only be read if a light source (like a flashlight or a glowrod) is held at a specific 45-degree angle to the surface, causing the shadows of the etchings to appear.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Thick sheets of clear plexiglass or, in colder sectors of the station, carved slabs of industrial ice that never melt due to localized cooling fields.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Stoic and Detached. They have a "spacewalker" mentality—lonely, quiet, and obsessed with oxygen and pressure stats. They rarely use verbs, preferring to list raw data. A sign for a kitchen might simply list the caloric density of the food inside.
known_ancestries: Various ancestries alien to the PF2e world
npc_groups.common_appearance: Pale, minimalist attire with practical accessories; often etched markings only visible in light.
npc_groups.demeanor: Reserved and introspective within the group; quiet and data‑oriented with others.

npc_groups.name: The Re-Animators
npc_groups.lettering: Stitched-together characters made from different textures of organic material (leathery, veined, or porous).
npc_groups.language_oddities: The signs are biologically active. If the "sign" gets "hungry," the edges might curl or turn grey, requiring a splash of nutrient solution (or a drop of blood) to become legible again.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Dried leather hides or cured "meat" parchment. Instead of ink, they use surgical sutures or cauterized burn marks to form words.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Disturbingly Biological. They view the station as a giant organism and the players as "microbes." They are not necessarily evil, just clinical and creepy. They might refer to a hallway as an "artery" or a door as a "sphincter."
npc_groups.common_appearance: Members wear face‑covering masks, clean lab coats or clinical garments, and well‑pressed professional attire underneath. Their look emphasizes sterility and precision—dark or neutral tones, minimal ornamentation, and purposeful gear such as gloves, medical belts, or instrument pouches. Their masks and clothing minimize personal expression, making the group appear impersonal and clinical.
npc_groups.demeanor: Exceptionally cold and analytical with one another; interactions with outsiders are matter‑of‑fact and detached. They prioritize procedure and protocol over emotion, often speaking in clinical terms and evaluating situations with scientific rigor.

npc_groups.name: The Gravity-Drunks
npc_groups.lettering: Spiraling, dizzying swirls of text that seem to "fall" across the surface of the sign.
npc_groups.language_oddities: The script has no fixed “up.” Clockwise and counterclockwise word order carry different grammatical meanings, distinguishing approach from departure.
npc_groups.signage_physical_form: Bouncy rubber balls printed with spiraling lenticular lettering, or metal slinkies stretched across doorways with letters dangling from their coils. Signs may be mounted on floors, ceilings, or behind pipes; lenticular versions change their displayed image as the viewer moves.
npc_groups.communication_quirks: Always Joking. They are addicted to the sensation of shifting gravity and find the concept of "up" and "down" to be a hilarious prank. Their signs are filled with puns and "dad jokes" about weightlessness, falling, and orbits.
npc_groups.common_appearance: Spiraled cloth, gravity‑themed prints, improvised floating ornaments.
npc_groups.demeanor: Jovial and joking together; playful and unpredictable with outsiders.

signs.description: A perfectly level, laminated A4 sheet of paper is attached to the door eye-level with industrial-strength adhesive, covered in microscopic, bone-dry text arranged in a soul-crushing grid.
signs.translation: Welcome to Station Sector 4-G. By exiting this portal, you agree to all 4,513 safety bylaws as noted below; note that Subsection R-9 strictly prohibits 'Sudden Running' or 'Unauthorized Sweating,' both of which are classified as Level-3 Security violations.

signs.description: A simple square of white paper is taped to the door with a piece of scotch tape, featuring neat, blocky English written in a black permanent marker.
signs.translation: Welcome! Please avoid [burn mark] will set off the security sensors. Reminder: If the door is locked for any reason, use the teleport to travel to [burn mark] and disengage the lockdown. Have a nice day!

signs.description: A patch of dried, veined leather is stitched directly into the door’s rubber seal with surgical staples, featuring words that appear to have been cauterized into the hide with a branding iron.
signs.translation: This outer membrane is currently closed to prevent infection.

signs.description: A long scroll of tattered synthetic fabric hangs upside down from the door frame, featuring blurry, collage-style letters cut out of various technical manuals and glued on in a jagged line.
signs.translation: You are pieces of a puzzle that does not want to be solved; be careful which shadow you step into first.

signs.description: A rough, pungent burlap patch soaked in a yellowish, greasy oil is slapped onto the door at waist height, featuring abstract organic splotches that seem to pulse when the air hits them.
signs.translation: Welcome to the Shared Breath; your individual thoughts are loud, but we will learn to ignore them together.

signs.description: A heavy basalt slab is bolted into the metal bulkhead with four massive iron rivets, featuring geometric cuneiform deeply chiseled into the stone that feels warm to the touch.
signs.translation: This portal has stood for sixty solar cycles. Should the mechanism fail to yield, return to the stone-gate of light and seek another shore.

signs.description: A jagged lattice of glowing fiber-optic wires is hooked into the upper corner of the doorway, twisting into chaotic 3D knots and intersections that cast legible shadows on the wall if viewed from the correct angle.
signs.translation: Chamber of Constructive Chaos: Tools of Fire and Potion Await.

signs.description: An octagonal scrap of sheet metal is bolted crookedly beside the door, scratched deeply with columns of binary and circuit diagrams meant to be read by touch.
signs.translation: HANDLE EQUIPMENT. HOT. SHARP. ALIVE.

signs.description: A translucent glass petri-dish suctioned to the wall beside the door slowly pulses with neon-green bioluminescent slime, letters swirling and shifting inside.
signs.translation: Psst… Careful, some things bite. But the blue mushroom tea is safe. Maybe.

signs.description: Flattened soda cans taped together in a crude rectangle, scribbled with half-melted crayon, stick figures, and X marks; the top corner is chewed away.
signs.translation: DANGER X X X. STUFF GOOD TO TAKE.

signs.description: Long strips of iridescent ribbon hang vertically from the ceiling, pinned with sparkling needles. The strips spin slightly in the air currents, messages flickering with motion.
signs.translation: SHINY FIRE! ⚡⚗️🛠️

signs.description: A jagged, hand-spun wire lattice is hooked into the ceiling corner above the door, its glowing fiber-optic knots casting complex, geometric shadows against the metal.
signs.translation: Welcome, esteemed travelers, to the Arboretum of Perpetual Whispers; we humbly request you do not startle the six-legged weavers in the canopy, as their defensive silk is quite difficult to remove from organic hides.

signs.description: A translucent glass petri-dish is suction-cupped to the door at eye level, filled with neon-green liquid that swirls into glowing, organic patterns as the door vibrates.
signs.translation: Hungry? The blue berries in the center grove are 90% sugar and only 10% hallucinogenic! Fun Fact: The 'Screaming Vines' aren't actually angry, they just vibrate at a frequency that causes human teeth to rattle!

signs.description: A rusted, circular fuel-canister lid is pinned to the wall with a spike, featuring words etched into the metal using concentrated acid that has created a permanent, crusty brown "ink."
signs.translation: The Green spreads like a cancer over the holy iron. Go inside and watch the roots eat the station; it is a beautiful, slow death. Drink the water—it tastes of copper and coming ends.

signs.description: A long, thin strip of iridescent ribbon is pinned to the door frame with shimmering needles, its tiny sequins spinning wildly in the ventilation draft to create a rhythmic blinking message.
signs.translation: SHINY LEAVES. GOOD WATER. FLYING BITERS. RUN FAST.

signs.description: A hammered gold-leaf plate is bolted to the center of the door, its elegant, flowing calligraphy reflecting the hallway lights with a divine shimmer.
signs.translation: Enter this sacred garden to harvest the bounty of the soil, but remember that the predators within are also the Hierophant's children; to be eaten is to be truly integrated. By the will of the Hierophant.

signs.description: A clear plexiglass placard flush with the doorframe reveals faint etched lines only when corridor lights strike it at an angle.
signs.translation: Pressure Stable. Oxygen High. Exit Access: Disabled. Cause: Biological Contamination.

connections.name: Heavy metal door
connections.short_description: Heavy metal door, can be barred a control panel in the Porcelain Passageways

signs.description: A delicate, asymmetrical web of glowing fiber-optic strands is anchored high in the upper corner of the doorway, its tangled intersections casting elegant, readable shadows only when viewed from a precise angle.
signs.translation: Sanctum of Recollected Echoes, Where Minds Are Gently Unspooled Before a Patient Audience—Please Engage With Care and Reverence.

signs.description: A roughly cut octagonal plate is welded directly into the wall beside the control panel, its surface gouged with deep vertical scratches forming harsh binary columns and circuit paths.
signs.translation: INPUT MIND. OUTPUT IMAGE. CONTROL DIFFICULT.

signs.description: A long strip of tattered synthetic fabric hangs crookedly over the doorway, its collage of mismatched letters appearing slightly blurred unless viewed through a reflective surface.
signs.translation: What is seen is not yours unless it already was—sit, and let the room decide what you remember.

signs.description: Curved glass tubes filled with softly glowing sand are mounted in an elegant arc above the entrance, faintly humming when disturbed, their note-patterns forming a flowing musical script.
signs.translation: Enter, and your past shall sing in trembling harmony—though some notes may refuse your command.

signs.description: A cracked tablet screen taped beside the door with neon duct tape flickers with glitching rainbow static and looping pixel icons.
signs.translation: 🎥🧠🔥 LET’S GOOOOO!!! MEMORY DROP ZONE!!! 🔥🧠🎥

connections.name: Plexiglass Door
connections.short_description: A spiral staircase down, behind a plexiglass door

signs.description: A crooked acrylic neon box floats slightly off the wall near the entrance, its flickering tubes displaying overlapping messages that phase in and out of sync.
signs.translation: WELCOME TO THE CORRECT MODEL (REVISION PENDING). PLANETS MAY NOT BE WHERE YOU REMEMBER THEM.

signs.description: A slightly wrinkled sheet of white paper is taped to a nearby wall, written in careful block letters with a black marker.
signs.translation: Please do not rearrange the orrery. The current configuration is intentional (we think).

signs.description: A perfectly level laminated document is affixed to the glass door, its impossibly dense grid of tiny text filling every available space.
signs.translation: All observational records contained within these shelves are cataloged under Temporal Filing System 88-C; removal, misplacement, or chronological misordering of any document constitutes a Class-7 infraction, regardless of whether the document has ‘already been moved’ in a future state.

signs.description: A thin ribbon of spinning mirrored sequins is attached to the wall on the far side of the plexiglass door, its surface flashing erratically as one walks past.
signs.translation: SPIN FAST = SEE TRUE.

signs.description: A matte-black silicone square is mounted over a small light fixture, its cut-out negative spaces only visible as glowing shapes projected onto the floor beneath it.
signs.translation: Only those who understand absence may perceive the hidden orbit.

connections.name: Spiral hallway
connections.short_description: A circular hallway that seems to travel in an infinite circle. Going backwards leads to a solid wall

connections.name: Spiral Staircase
connections.short_description: A spiral staircase up, ending behind a plexiglass door

signs.description: A scorched octagonal metal plate is welded directly onto a nearby pipe, its deeply gouged vertical markings forming harsh, tactile columns of binary and schematic lines.
signs.translation: COOLANT REQUIRED. HEAT RISE = EXPLOSION.

signs.description: A wobbling, translucent pouch of glowing blue-green slime is suction-cupped to the side of the pool, its internal swirls lazily forming cheerful, drifting symbols.
signs.translation: The big machine gets VERY cranky when it’s hot! Keep the water nice and cool and it’ll fix your stuff like magic!

signs.description: A thick, rectangular slab of dark basalt is bolted firmly into the floor beside the pool, its deeply carved symbols radiating faint warmth along key lines.
signs.translation: Restoration Engine. Submersion Mandated for Thermal Stability. Failure to Maintain Cooling Will Result in Violent Structural Dissolution. Installed Year 3891. Expected Failure: Imminent (Within Acceptable Margin).

signs.description: A cracked monitor taped to a railing with neon duct tape flickers with rainbow static and looping pixel animations, occasionally emitting a burst of upbeat electronic noise.
signs.translation: 💧🔥⚙️ LET’S FIX IT!!! SPLASH ZONE!!! 🔥💧⚙️

signs.description: A clear pane of plexiglass is mounted just above the waterline, its fine etched markings only visible when light hits at a precise angle, though part of the surface is fogged and scratched.
signs.translation: Critical Temperature Threshold: [DAMAGE]. Minimum Liquid Level: [DAMAGE]. Detonation Probability: [DAMAGE].

signs.description: Jagged wire lattice hooked high into a ceiling corner; glowing fiber-optic intersections form three-dimensional letters that cast shadows when viewed from the right angle.
signs.translation: The Left Behind. Remembered here, though the rest of the station pretends not to notice.

signs.description: Petri-dish filled with shifting neon-green slime suction-cupped to a plate; the text drifts slowly over time.
signs.translation: Names? Possibly edible? Fun fact: slime expands more in quiet rooms.

signs.description: Long, thin iridescent ribbons pinned to a ceiling cluster; tiny spinning sequins catch the light in a rapid, confusing blink.
signs.translation: SHINY! Maybe important… or maybe just glitter.

signs.description: Laminated A4 sheet stuck crookedly to a beam, dense tiny text forming a perfect bureaucratic grid; the adhesive is industrial-strength.
signs.translation: All persons previously registered in this quadrant must ensure forms 4B, 7C, and 92-Z are completed. Also, the room may or may not contain relevant artifacts.

signs.description: Clear plexiglass panel etched with microscopic indentations; readable only when the light strikes at 45°, revealing faint shadowed letters.
signs.translation: Observation: multiple objects hang. Potential significance unknown. Oxygen levels stable.

signs.description: Bouncy rubber ball dangling from a thin wire above the head; text spirals across its surface, moving slightly as the ball sways.
signs.translation: Up? Down? Maybe someone fell… or maybe not. Wheee!

connections.name: Heavy metal door
connections.short_description: Heavy metal door, sealed due to security lockdown

connections.name: Underwater door
connections.short_description: See note on The Crystal Mug about arrival/departure.

signs.description: A sealed plastic pouch of glowing neon-green liquid is suction-cupped beside the entrance archway, its swirling text drifting lazily around suspended crystal fragments inside the pouch.
signs.translation: Welcome, friend! Refreshments this way! Fun fact: some crystals grow faster when complimented. Have you told a crystal it looks nice today?

signs.description: A curved glass tube filled with softly humming singing sands hangs from a crystal cluster above the bar, vibrating gently in a warm major chord.
signs.translation: A place of fellowship, song, drink, and stories polished bright as gemstones.

signs.description: A thick basalt plaque bolted directly into a crystal-covered support column, its deep geometric carvings warm to the touch at key words.
signs.translation: STRUCTURE STABLE. CRYSTAL GROWTH ACCEPTABLE. ESTIMATED SERVICE LIFE OF ESTABLISHMENT: 4,800 YEARS. LAST INSPECTION: 27 YEARS AGO.

signs.description: A metal slinky stretches diagonally across a doorway between dining areas, dangling letters spinning gently whenever someone passes.
signs.translation: WARNING: The drinks may improve your sense of direction or make gravity significantly funnier.

signs.description: A square sheet of black silicone is mounted over a lantern near a private booth corridor, projecting cut-out letters onto the floor in pale crystal-reflected light.
signs.translation: Reserved Chamber for Quiet Reflection, Discreet Meetings, and Those Worthy of Fine Vintage Spirits.

signs.description: A slightly yellowed sheet of paper taped carefully at eye level on a porcelain column, its clean block lettering stark against the overwhelming white reflections of the room.
signs.translation: Bathing area. Do not drink from faucets unless you know what is coming out.

signs.description: A silk banner with gold-tasseled edges draped awkwardly over a clawfoot tub, ornate calligraphy shimmering faintly as it catches the mist, the incense-scented ink slightly smudged by humidity.
signs.translation: Behold the sacred Rite of Purification wherein the vessel is cleansed by ever-shifting divine waters. All forms of contamination are to be surrendered. By the will of the Hierophant.

signs.description: A curved glass tube filled with softly glowing sand mounted above a basin, humming faintly; the pitch fluctuates as mist drifts through it, altering the tone mid-note.
signs.translation: Shhhhhh… the room is asleep and listening to itself breathe.

signs.description: A laminated multi-page document bolted to a porcelain pillar with industrial adhesive, so dense with microscopic text it appears as a gray block unless inspected closely under harsh light.
signs.translation: NOTICE: All personnel entering the Porcelain Hydrological Annex must acknowledge Section 12.4.3 regarding non-standard liquid classifications, including but not limited to: stellar emulsions, reflective gels, sentimental humidity, and/or substances exhibiting temporary anatomical suggestibility. Failure to comply may result in undefined outcomes. Additional bathing protocols may or may not apply depending on jurisdictional ambiguity.

signs.description: A clear plexiglass slab suspended near a basin, etched with microscopic markings that only appear when mist condenses at a precise angle, briefly outlining shifting numerical readouts.
signs.translation: Humidity: extreme. Visibility: reduced. Liquid states in circulation: 14 confirmed, 3 indeterminate. Sound attenuation approaching maximum theoretical threshold.

connections.name: Door that was once blocked by a massive tree

signs.description: A laminated A4 sheet bolted onto the doorframe at a precise 0.0-degree alignment, its dense microscopic text illuminated by flickering neon pink from a broken display screen.
signs.translation: All transactions within the Commercial Logistics Corridor are subject to multi-jurisdictional procurement statutes, including but not limited to: exchange parity anomalies, sentient inventory classification disputes, and mandatory acknowledgment that vending units may constitute sovereign micro-enterprises. Please retain receipts for eternity or until audit completion, whichever occurs first.

signs.description: A flattened soda can nailed crookedly just above the door controls, covered in crayon stick figures pointing at glowing squares labeled with crude “X” and “CIRCLE” marks.
signs.translation: X bite bad. Circle snack good. Shiny box mine now.

signs.description: A flickering neon tube sign above the door shows a version of the corridor that is slightly older or newer, with vending machines appearing and disappearing between frames.
signs.translation: You already bought this item. You will buy it again. Please proceed to checkout that hasn’t happened yet.

signs.description: A simple white paper sign taped between to the left of the door, slightly curled at the edges from heat exposure.
signs.translation: Try not to get trapped in here. If you can’t find exit B, go back the way you came and ignore the blinking machine that says it knows you.

signs.description: A broken monitor duct-taped below the door controls, flashing rainbow static and looping a one-second burst of distorted celebratory music whenever someone is nearby.
signs.translation: WELCOME TO THE SUPPLY ZONE!!! EVERYTHING IS ON SALE!!! (INCLUDING YOUR ITEMS!!!)

connections.short_description: Requires flight or an airship to move between islands

signs.description: An octagonal piece of scorched hull plating is bolted to the left side of the enormous doorframe at waist height, covered in deeply gouged vertical columns of binary code and crude circuit diagrams.
signs.translation: VEHICLES. MOVING. KEEP CLEAR. DOOR CRUSHES.

signs.description: A delicate, irregular lattice of glowing blue fiber-optic threads hangs from the ceiling corner above the entrance, its tangled knots casting intricate shadows that resemble flowing calligraphy.
signs.translation: We humbly welcome all esteemed travelers to the Chamber of Elevated Conveyances, where weary passengers and their burdens may be transported with the utmost dignity and efficiency.

signs.description: A perfectly rectangular sheet of laminated white paper is permanently adhered beside the door controls, filled edge-to-edge with microscopic black Gothic lettering arranged in impossibly precise grids.
signs.translation: NOTICE: Audible warnings accompanying the opening or closing of this portal shall be interpreted as notification of imminent mechanical movement, and shall not be construed as invitations to enter, musical performances, or indications of emergency unless accompanied by additional authorized signals.

signs.description: A small crescent-shaped arrangement of curved glass tubes filled with shimmering silver sand is fastened to the corridor wall beside the door, the tubes forming delicate musical notes that vibrate softly.
signs.translation: Within these walls, the crystal hearts of our faithful chariots shall rest, replenish their celestial harmonies, and rise once more to carry us onward.

signs.description: A brightly colored metal slinky is stretched diagonally between two exposed pipes above the door, with tiny dangling plastic letters arranged in a dizzying spiral that changes appearance as the viewer moves.
signs.translation: What goes up must come down! Unless it's a hovercart. Then you're just making things up.

signs.description: A thick, rectangular panel of transparent plexiglass is bolted to the corridor wall beside the massive circular door, bearing microscopic geometric etchings that become visible only when illuminated at a sharp angle.
signs.translation: Atmospheric isolation: mandatory. Thermal deviation: unacceptable. Pressure equalization: required before entry. Unprotected exposure: hazardous.

signs.description: A perfectly rectangular sheet of laminated white paper is adhered to the wall beside the door controls, covered in microscopic black Gothic lettering arranged into dozens of impossibly dense, numbered paragraphs.
signs.translation: All requests for occupant retrieval, reinsertion, reassignment, or inspection must be submitted through the designated processing terminal at the far end of the accessway. Unauthorized manipulation of registered occupants shall result in immediate suspension of retrieval privileges, pending investigation and completion of Form 88-C (Improper Interference with Stationary Personnel).

signs.description: A small, irregular oval of leathery organic parchment is stitched directly onto the outer doorframe, its veined characters formed from dark surgical sutures, although several symbols have been partially eaten away by tiny scavenging organisms.
signs.translation: The flesh rests. The blood slows. The mind waits. Disturb not the preservation of the vessel before the appointed renewal.

signs.description: A narrow crescent-shaped arrangement of curved glass tubes containing softly humming silver sand is mounted high above the doorway, forming delicate musical staffs and notes that shimmer with pale violet light.
signs.translation: Here the weary surrender their hours to silence, while the stars continue their eternal dance. Let no careless hand disturb the sleeping melody.

signs.description: A brightly colored rubber ball is permanently suspended from a short chain attached to the corridor ceiling just outside the door, covered in spiraling lenticular letters that seem to tumble across its surface as it sways.
signs.translation: I asked the universe for some personal space. It gave me a vacuum. Worst roommate EVER.

connections.short_description: A sign over the door auto-translates to "Atmosphere: Good" with a color that the viewer interprets as "good" (often green).

signs.description: A narrow hexagonal sheet of transparent plexiglass is embedded in the corridor floor immediately before the dock entrance, its microscopic etchings nearly invisible except when illuminated at a precise angle.
signs.translation: Atmospheric boundary: permeable. Exterior pressure: negligible. Oxygen supply beyond boundary: zero. Freedom of movement: unrestricted.

signs.description: An octagonal slab of recycled hull plating is welded beside the dock's entrance controls, covered in vertical columns of roughly gouged binary code and deeply scratched circuit diagrams.
signs.translation: CARGO. TRANSFER. PASSENGERS. BOARD. LOAD LIMITS APPLY. CRATES EMPTY. REUSE.

signs.description: A flattened, circular soda can is riveted crookedly to the outer doorframe at knee height, bearing crude charcoal stick figures, several large X marks, and a roughly drawn mechanical claw reaching toward a box.
signs.translation: BIG GRABBY THING BROKE. DON'T FEED IT BOXES. WE TRIED. BOXES STILL OURS.

signs.description: A narrow triangular banner of ivory silk with gold-tasseled fringes hangs from a silver bracket above the entrance, its sweeping golden calligraphy embellished with tiny halos and intricate flourishes.
signs.translation: Beyond this threshold lies the sacred meeting of countless peoples, where vessels of the heavens surrender their travelers and treasures unto the station's embrace. May all who arrive find sanctuary, and all who depart carry blessings into the endless dark. By the will of the Hierophant.

signs.description: A round, translucent glass dish filled with softly pulsing neon-green slime is suction-cupped to the corridor wall beside the door, its glowing swirls forming cheerful, rounded symbols that slowly drift through the liquid.
signs.translation: Welcome to the docking zone! Remember, the pretty shimmering edge is NOT a wall! Fun fact: Most organisms only get to experience explosive decompression once! Have a squishy day!

signs.description: A small square sheet of matte-black silicone is mounted over a recessed light above the dock entrance, its precisely cut negative-space glyphs projecting faint, angular shadows onto the floor.
signs.translation: The boundary is an agreement, not a prison. Those who understand the emptiness need no protection from it.

signs.description: A thin hexagonal sheet of perfectly transparent plexiglass is embedded flush with the corridor wall beside the entrance, its microscopic etchings forming nearly invisible angular symbols that can only be read when light strikes them at precisely 45 degrees.
signs.translation: Designation: Final Inheritance. Origin: Those Who Endure the Emptiness. Intended recipients: Worlds Yet Unborn. Purpose: Repayment of Ancient Debts. Delivery: Deferred. Forgiveness: Never.

signs.description: A small, rainbow-colored rubber ball is permanently suspended from a magnetic bracket on the corridor ceiling outside the entrance, its spiraling lenticular lettering appearing to fall endlessly around its surface.
signs.translation: What's the difference between a dragon and a constellation? One's a star attraction, and the other's a real drag-on!

signs.description: An irregular oval patch of coarse burlap is permanently affixed to the corridor wall beside the doorway, its surface covered in overlapping amber and violet grease-like splotches that emit a pungent, sweet odor.
signs.translation: All who pass this threshold become part of the greater whole. The great watchers recognize every visitor as kin and deliver them to the great final treasure.

signs.description: A crooked strip of tattered synthetic parchment hangs upside down from the corridor wall beside the entrance, covered in mismatched cutout characters that shimmer and blur as though viewed through rippling water.
signs.translation: Two serpents without scales, a sky without a sun, a prize without a price. Tell us, little thief, what can wound the unwound and silence the eternal? We know. We know. WE KNOW. But we will not tell you.

signs.description: A tiny triangular sticker of bright pink plastic is permanently affixed to the underside of the doorway's upper frame, decorated with garish pictograms of two enormous dragons, a tiny stick figure, and a glittering trophy surrounded by exaggerated lightning bolts.
signs.translation: SECRET BOSS ROOM?! DRAGON DRAGON LOOT! GOOD LUCK, NERD!

signs.description: A small crescent of curved glass tubes containing softly vibrating silver sand is suspended from a ceiling pipe outside the doorway, forming unfamiliar musical staffs intertwined with tiny representations of stars.
signs.translation: Two ancient wyrms embrace the heavens, guarding a note that must never be sung. The stars within know neither our names nor our songs, yet tremble at the silence awaiting them.

connections.short_description: An ornate door that appears to be made from carved stone. A sign over the door automatically translates to “Hall of Fallen Worlds”.

signs.description: A heavy, rectangular slab of dark basalt is bolted into the corridor wall beside the doorframe, bearing deeply chiseled geometric cuneiform whose largest symbols radiate a faint warmth.
signs.translation: Let the Great Anchor endure beyond the passing of ten thousand generations. Should its heart grow silent, all paths bound to it shall perish. Erected in the 8,412th Cycle. Expected service: 90,000 years.

signs.description: A battered octagonal plate of recycled steel is welded directly above the door controls, its surface scarred with vertical columns of deeply gouged binary digits and angular circuit diagrams.
signs.translation: FOUR UNITS. DETACHABLE. DEPLOY. RETURN. RECHARGE.

signs.description: A small, crooked triangular acrylic box hangs above the right corner of the doorway, containing flickering violet neon tubes that form shifting symbols occasionally doubled by ghostly afterimages.
signs.translation: Teleportation Research Annex! Or was it the Transportation Department? Sorry, the renovations haven't happened yet.

signs.description: A narrow, transparent hexagonal sheet of thick plexiglass is mounted flush against the corridor wall near the door's hinges, its microscopic etchings appearing as delicate silver lines when illuminated from an oblique angle.
signs.translation: Spatial displacement chamber. Anchor synchronization: mandatory. Remote operating range: anchor-dependent. Independent operation: unsupported.

signs.description: A tiny triangular sticker of neon-orange plastic is permanently affixed upside down to the bottom of the doorframe, covered in garish pictograms showing a grinning face, a swirling portal, and a cartoon skeleton giving two thumbs up.
signs.translation: YEET YOURSELF INTO THE UNKNOWN! WHAT COULD POSSIBLY GO WRONG?

connections.short_description: Sealed by an airtight, reinforced blast door.
